entities.summary: Eugène Boban or Boban-Duvergé (1834–1908) was a French antiquarian. He was the official archaeologist of the court of Maximilian I of Mexico, and a member of the French Scientific Commission in Mexico. He is known as a crystal skulls collector and dealer, one which is now in the Musée du Quai Branly and another in the British Museum.
